independent_review.verdict:
No actionable introduced defects found in this Issue 9 scope.

Reviewed `services/converse/intent.py`, `services/converse/runtime.py`, `services/converse/api.py`, `services/converse/windows.py`, `services/resources/coordinator.py`, `services/resources/client.py`, `services/resources/state.py`, `services/resources/providers.py`, `services/launcher.py`, `docs/adr/0023-converse-owner-intent.md`, `tests/integration/test_converse_owner_controls.py`, `tests/integration/test_converse_owner_processes.py`, `tests/unit/test_converse_intent.py`, and Flutter `app_state.dart` diff against requirements.

Owner choice stays separate from resource pause. Automatic `restore`/`task_finished` re-reads intent and settles to `off` when disabled. Both owner paths share `converse-intent.json` with atomic replace, nonblocking lock, and revision advance. Old receipt replay returns stored result without rewriting newer choice. Owner ack persists before any journal/delivery await and does not hold worker `asyncio.Lock`. Managed Converse starts suspended and only opens after verified readiness. Direct Agent controls remain independent. Stale speech is blocked by `runtime_id` plus `owner_intent_revision` and `availability_generation` rechecks around async work.

No new concurrency, persistence, authorization, revision/idempotency, restart, or async-speech violation introduced in the supplied diff was identified. Physical playback and real model inference remain outside this fixture as stated.
independent_review.limits: Separate actual read-only CLI instance, one model step, no tools or tests; supplied public committed sources. Automated review, not independent human approval.
